newsitem.title: USA: Tosco hydrocracker made jet, gas -- trader.
newsitem.headline: Tosco hydrocracker made jet, gas -- trader.

text.p: The hydrocracker shut late Thursday at Tosco Corp's Wilmington plant in California made gasoline and jet fuel, according to a trader familiar with plant operations.
The unit, shut because of a fire, has a capacity of 25,000 barrels-per-day. The trader said the unit's return date was unknown, reiterating earlier statements from a Tosco official.

Prices were unchanged for wholesale gasoline and jet fuel in early West Coast discussion, as traders wondered about the duration and extent of damage. They also tried to figure out what type of products the unit produced.
One broker claimed jet fuel might get the greatest boost if the unit were badly damaged.
"It doubt (the fire) will have much impact unless it's jet because jet's tight," the broker said earlier.
Prompt wholesale jet prices rose 0.50 cents a gallon late Thursday on rumors of lost production at Chevron's northern California plant.
